items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: I was selling newspaper right there for Cora, on the next street. I was selling paper for Cora, for Ms. Cora.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was selling newspaper. I was selling newspaper right there for Cora, on the next street. I was selling paper for Cora, for Ms. Cora. And all those, and then the place around here, you can call. They don't know me. White, colored, all.
I hear the musicians talk about you plenty.
